subject: Making it so ASAN failures fail the CI workflows (#115)
reason: The change modifies only tst/integration/run.sh, the valkey-json CI test-runner script: it adds ASAN/LSAN option exports, pipefail, and log-scanning so ASAN errors, memory leaks, and pytest failures fail the CI job. No module source code is touched, so the built valkey-json module is behaviourally identical on both sides — no command, reply, persistence, or replication path changes exist for a scenario to exercise. This is a pure CI/build-infrastructure change and needs no fuzzer scenario.
